# Contributing

Thanks for helping improve this Home Assistant add-on. Search existing
[issues](https://github.com/kitos9112/addon-influxdb/issues) and
[pull requests](https://github.com/kitos9112/addon-influxdb/pulls) before opening
a new one. Include Home Assistant version, add-on version, architecture, logs
with secrets removed, and steps to reproduce when reporting a bug.

For code changes, describe the motivation and test results in your pull request.
CI checks shell scripts, ingress rendering, and both supported container
architectures. Please follow the existing code style and update documentation
when behavior changes.

Follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) in project discussions.
Report security issues privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
